# Public contract source

Unmodified `packages/contracts` from `lamplitisles/lamplit-app` commit
`98d55d1019ad102e46dbde8526bf6f1e32af097b`, the `lamplit-app.sha` consumed by
CFL `fb37c504754781816794d7e7dd4b5ec235d3cb50`.
Source: https://github.com/lamplitisles/lamplit-app/tree/98d55d1019ad102e46dbde8526bf6f1e32af097b/packages/contracts
